Build upper body strength anywhere with this 15-minute upper body military calisthenics workout — no equipment needed.
Looking for a stuctured bodyweight-only training plan? Get on NO EXCUSES training. Weekly updated programming you can do anywhere to buld muscle, burn fat, and drop excuses!
We’ll work for 40 seconds and rest for 20 seconds through 15 different exercises. The movements are strategically rotated between muscle groups so you can maintain quality reps and intensity throughout the entire workout without burning out one area too early.
